journey.name: wear pager settings about
journey.description:
Swiping left on Balance shows the Settings page; About shows the app version and network; swipe-to-dismiss returns to Settings and a swipe right returns to Balance. Emulator and physical watch.
Precondition: Restored wallet, see journeys/wear/README.md › Restored wallet. Backend: hosted regtest. Gestures are in README › Watch gestures. The watch takes the phone app's version name, and the phone's version code plus 1 000 000 000 (docs/wear.md › Version): phone 3.1.1 (197) gives watch "3.1.1 (1000000197)".

actions.action: Verify the Balance page: "WatchHomeBalance" is listed
Swipe the pager left: `adb shell input swipe 400 227 60 227 300`
Verify the Settings page: About (tag "WatchSettingsAbout") is listed
Run `adb shell dumpsys package to.bitkit.dev | grep -E 'versionName|versionCode'` and note both values
Verify "WatchAboutVersion" reads "<versionName> (<versionCode>)" with the values noted, such as "3.1.1 (1000000197)"
Swipe to dismiss from the left edge: `adb shell input swipe 20 227 400 227 300`
Verify the Settings page again: "WatchSettingsAbout" is listed
Swipe the pager right: `adb shell input swipe 100 227 420 227 300`
Verify the Balance page: "WatchHomeBalance" is listed
